name: QuarkLeads
author: quarkleads

sections.description:
Seamlessly connect your WordPress website to the QuarkLeads – World’s Most Advanced Lead Management Platform with this lightweight integration plugin. QuarkLeads helps businesses automate lead capture, follow-ups, and sales workflows — and this plugin bridges your WordPress contact forms directly to your QuarkLeads account in just a few clicks.

Key Features:

• Effortless Integration – Connect popular WordPress form builders like Contact Form 7, Elementor Forms, Ninja Forms, WPForms, Gravity Forms, and others to your QuarkLeads account.
• Admin Panel Integration – Simple and intuitive settings panel within your WordPress dashboard for managing API keys, mappings, and logs.
• Real-Time Data Sync – Automatically send form submissions (name, email, phone, etc.) from your website to your QuarkLeads CRM for instant follow-up.
• Lightweight & Secure – Built with performance in mind, ensuring minimal load on your site and secure API communication using SSL.
• WP-Cron Based Cleanup System – Automatic maintenance and log cleanup for optimal database performance.
• Detailed Logs – View complete logs of API requests, responses, and any errors for transparency and troubleshooting.
• Data Privacy & Compliance – Only mapped forms send data; nothing else is transmitted without explicit configuration.

Integration Points

The QuarkLeads plugin supports seamless integration with the following WordPress form plugins:

• Contact Form 7
• Elementor Forms
• Ninja Forms
• WPForms
• Gravity Forms
• Formidable Forms
• Fluent Forms

Each form can be mapped individually within the QuarkLeads plugin settings, ensuring precise control over what data is sent and when.

External services

This plugin connects to an external service provided by QuarkLeads to send and synchronize form submissions with your QuarkLeads CRM account.

  • Service: QuarkLeads API (https://server.quarkleads.in)
  • What data is sent: When a mapped form is submitted, the plugin transmits user-provided data such as name, email, phone number, and related metadata required for synchronization.
  • When data is sent: Data is sent only when a mapped form is submitted by a site visitor.
  • Purpose: To forward and manage leads efficiently in your QuarkLeads CRM for automation, sales tracking, and follow-ups.
  • Privacy & Terms: By using this plugin, you agree to the external API connection for the sole purpose of form data synchronization. No additional domains are contacted.
    • QuarkLeads Terms of Service
    • QuarkLeads Privacy Policy

No other external domains are contacted by this plugin.

Developer-Friendly:

Built with extendable hooks and filters, allowing developers to customize data flow, API requests, and logging for advanced use cases.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Quarkleads API under the admin menu.
  4. Configure your credentials and start managing leads.
sections.faq:
Does this support Contact Form 7?

Yes it supports Contact Form 7.

Does this support WP Forms?

Yes it supports WP Forms.

Does it store leads locally?

Your form data will be stored locally by your respective form plugin or code but this plugin does not store any data locally. Leads are pushed directly to the QuarkLeads panel through this plugin and QuarkLeads API. API logs are kept for forever or as configured by you 10–30 days.
